label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
body: CRM helps you organize and track all interactions with your customers and potential customers in one place.
caption:
Imagine you're a freelance graphic designer. Instead of hunting through emails, spreadsheets, and sticky notes for client details or past project notes, a CRM keeps everything tidy. You can see when you last spoke, what they're interested in, and quickly follow up. It's a handy tool for keeping your customer conversations smooth and organized.
